notes:
Beta 1.5.17 - server badges patched at cache-write, not just cache-read.

Fix: residual flicker still happened on the very first bind of a freshly-cached chat (read happened before our per-read hook re-patched). PutChatBadgeHook now intercepts putChat / putChats / putChatFull and applies the server badge BEFORE the chat lands in MessagesController, so the icon is present at the first read. All cache paths now use allow_fetch=False so the hook never blocks on network.
